**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 3 (the call) is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk. The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs run` calls an extension end to end. Codegen emits `InstKind::ExtensionCall` as a variadic call of `nvs_runtime::extension::nvs_extension_call` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/extension.rs` module doc), and `nvs-cli`'s `extensions::Calls` hosts it over one `nvs_ext::call::Request` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc).

Every row of `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`'s table crosses both ways. A resource `Route` of `Shop\Ledger` is the member-less class `Shop\Route`, and at run time an object of a class `nvs_stdlib::ext_record::resource` makes for that name, holding the request's number for it (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs` module doc). The ledger fixture exports `openRoute` and `routeStop`, and `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-resource-is-held-by-the-program-and-passed-back.nvst` covers it.

**Still open in Stage 3:** a limit is a plain `FATAL` with no limit handler, and `nvs serve` installs no `Calls`. Stage 4 (qualifiers) is the driver's earliest red check and has nothing written yet.

items.text: **A limit runs the limit handler**: map `Outcome::Fatal` to `nvs_runtime::Limit` and run `Ctx::run_limit_handler` before the `FATAL` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:270`). `rule:packaging/a-guest-crash-throws`, `rule:errors/on-limit`.

**`nvs serve` hosts extension calls**: install a `Calls` per request from the live set (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:161`), ended when the request ends. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

backlog: Stage 4, qualifiers: the `nvs-types` sink and `secret` tests, the `nvs-ext` `load` tests and the four `.nvst` cases the goal record names (`data/goals/ext-compiler.json`).
Stage 5, the source section; Stage 6, the tools (`nvs check`, `nvs test`, the language server) — `data/goals/ext-compiler.json`.
